capabilities: Import Google Calendar events into events/ notes
Import Google Tasks into tasks/ notes
Push edits from linked notes back to Google
Archive old, completed, and orphaned notes into archive folders
Connect using a user-supplied Google OAuth client
disambiguation: Not a full two-way sync: it only imports and updates existing Google items and never creates or deletes anything in Google.
extras: Users must supply their own Google OAuth client ID, secret, and hosted redirect bridge page; tokens are stored in the vault's plugin data and should be treated as private. A headless Node build of the same sync engine can run outside Obsidian for cron use and can commit the vault to git. Startup import is off by default.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to bring Google Calendar events and Tasks into a vault as editable notes or send edits back to Google.

relations.evidence: do not use Templater folder-template auto-runs on Google Sync's managed events/ or tasks/ folders

requires.name: Google Cloud project with Calendar and Tasks APIs and an OAuth client plus hosted redirect bridge

summary: Google sync plugin that imports Calendar events and Tasks as frontmatter-linked notes and pushes edits back to existing Google items.
